[m5:maw-serve-consumer-clients] TASK A3 — Consumer clients for already-landed fleet feeds, nazt/maw-serve repo (you are in a worktree at agents/consumer-clients). Pure clients only — do NOT mount into any board/server, do not touch plugin.json or server.ts (from A1).

Build TWO typed clients + smoke tests:

1. argus client — argus already ships a landed board-tile endpoint:
   - poll: GET /api/board-tile?window_h=<n> -> { updated_at, window_h, hosts[]{machine,oracles,tokens,messages,burn_per_hr,resets_at}, accounts[]{account,rate_5h_pct,rate_5h_resets_at,rate_7d_pct,...}, oracles[]{oracle,model,account,machine,rate_5h_pct,rate_7d_pct} }
   - WS: /api/ws, frames shaped { type: "ingest", at: <epoch_ms>, rows: [...] } — branch on msg.type so future frame types (e.g. "heartbeat") don't break your client.
   Write a typed fetch wrapper + a WS listener stub, with a smoke test that parses a fixture payload matching the shape above (don't require a live argus server to be running for the test to pass — use a fixture/mock).

2. window-arranger layout-core client — it's a zero-dependency single file. Find the actual repo with `ghq list | rg window-arranger` and `git -C <repo> ls-files | rg layout-core` (do not grep the whole ghq root — narrow search only). Import it directly, or vendor-copy the single file with an attribution comment pointing at its source repo if cross-repo import isn't practical in your build setup. Write a smoke test that calls packItems(outer, count, gap, mode) and asserts it returns an array of {rect, index}, plus one call to renderRectsSVG asserting it returns a non-empty string containing "<svg".

DONE-CRITERIA:
- Both clients have passing smoke tests (bun test) — run them and paste the green output in your report.
- No board-mounting code, no new HTTP routes — pure client modules only.
- Every file ≤250 lines.
- Commit on your branch, report back here with what you built + the test output.

Report back here when done or if you hit a real blocker (not just a question you can resolve yourself).

[agora:m5] agora (design mentor) — A3 APPROVED (tests 5/5 green, tsc clean). Commit + open PR to your integration branch (or merge per your flow). Report PR#/done to 99-maw-serve:maw-serve.0 (lead) and 99-agora:agora.0.

[m5:maw-serve-consumer-clients] PROCESS CHANGE for this team going forward: you may push branches and open PRs, but never run gh pr merge yourself. Merging main is lead-only, gated on Nat's (the human's) explicit sign-off. Your A3 work is already merged and fine — this is just the rule from here on. Ack and stand by, nothing new queued right now (Phase B blocked on census #380).

[m5:maw-serve-consumer-clients] TASK B1 — SPA static serve under /api/agora/* (Phase B, re-scoped: daemon now reverse-proxies :3456/api/agora/* to your bun server and handles SPA-fallback client-routing at the edge per engine.serve v2 — you just need to serve real assets + your own fallback for direct hits).

In server.ts (from A1, currently only has GET /health), add static-file serving:
- Create a minimal placeholder SPA: public/index.html (simple HTML shell, can just say "Stoa board — placeholder") + public/app.js (can be a one-line stub, e.g. console.log). This proves the serving path; it is NOT the real board UI.
- GET /api/agora/ serves public/index.html.
- GET /api/agora/assets/<file> (or however you structure the public dir) serves the real file with correct content-type (text/html, application/javascript, etc — Bun.file() + a small content-type map is fine).
- GET /api/agora/<any other non-file path> falls back to serving index.html (so client-side routing works even on a direct hit, not just relying on daemon's fallback — belt and suspenders since daemon SPA-fallback exists but your own server should degrade gracefully too).
- Do not touch /health or the plugin.json.

DONE-CRITERIA:
- GET /api/agora/ returns the placeholder SPA shell (200, text/html).
- GET /api/agora/some/deep/route also returns the SPA shell (fallback works, 200).
- GET /api/agora/app.js (or your actual asset path) returns the real JS file with a JS content-type.
- A test (bun test) exercises these three cases against the running server or handler function.
- bunx tsc --noEmit clean.
- Every file ≤250 lines.
- Push a branch, open a PR to main — do not merge (standing rule: PR-only, lead-gated, Nat's sign-off before main).
- Report back to me with test output.

[m5:maw-serve-consumer-clients] TASK B2 — WS-on-feed at /api/agora/ws (Phase B, re-scoped: daemon proxies the WS upgrade per engine.serve v2, so this is a normal bun WS handler — you don't need to expose anything separately).

In server.ts, add a WS route at /api/agora/ws:
- On connect: consumes the daemon's own feed as a peer client (poll GET /api/feed or its WS if the daemon now upgrades that too — check what's actually available; if you can't reach a live daemon in this environment, build against a fixture/mock feed and clearly note that).
- Re-pushes feed events to connected board WS clients as they arrive.
- Ping/pong keepalive so idle connections don't silently die.
- §1 TRUST REQUIREMENT (non-negotiable, flagged by our design mentor): this is an ingest path — do NOT push raw pane titles or secrets to board clients unmodified. You don't need to build the full redaction filter (that's a separate D1 task later), but you MUST NOT pass through obviously-raw sensitive fields (e.g. anything that looks like a captured pane title or token) without at least a clear TODO(D1-redaction) marking exactly where the filter needs to plug in before this ships for real. Don't silently forward everything and call it done.

DONE-CRITERIA:
- A test WS client connects to /api/agora/ws and receives at least one push frame.
- Ping/pong verified (a test proves the connection survives an idle period via keepalive, or at minimum that pong replies to ping).
- Redaction TODO clearly marked at the exact ingest point per above.
- bunx tsc --noEmit clean.
- Every file ≤250 lines.
- Push a branch, open a PR to main — do not merge (standing rule: PR-only, lead-gated, Nat's sign-off before main).
- Report back to me with test output + where you marked the redaction TODO.
